environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster but the plugin pod is fronted by an nginx-ingress controller configured with annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-client: 'on' and auth-tls-secret pointing to a CA bundle (cicd-plugins/client-ca-cert). The ingress resource specifies auth-tls-verify-depth: '1' and auth-tls-pass-certificate-to-upstream: 'true'. Additionally, a Cilium NetworkPolicy (kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy) restricts all ingress to the plugin pod to ONLY originate from the ingress controller pods (label: app.kubernetes.io/name=ingress-nginx) on port 8080. The client certificate CA is an internal PKI managed by Vault with a 4-hour TTL and requires OIDC authentication to the 'cicd-operators' identity group before issuance. No other network path exists to the pod.
